name: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, maintenance, upgrade and repair, renewal, and installation of elevators, vertical automatic conveyors, and other transport machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers elevators, freight elevators, ship elevators, and maclifter. Its products are used in government agencies, public corporations, freezers and refrigerated warehouses, seafood, manufacturing, trading companies, commercial businesses, real estate sector, Construction company, ship, and warehouse and transportation industries.
